subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Be Who God Created You To Be
email_body:
Hi Russ,

I came across Be Who God Created You To Be: Living Out Your Faith in Today's World and was struck by how it speaks to living out faith in everyday life, as well as the personal study guide that accompanies it. Your path from pastor in Earl, North Carolina to published author is the kind of story our readers enjoy.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

Your book already reaches listeners as an audiobook, which is wonderful. If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for the book is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, from script to final edit. This is entirely optional.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Be Who God Created You To Be best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
